notes.title: Visit a mystical Montreal corner shop in this lovely little indie game
notes.notes:
Need anything from the shop? Mushroom milk? Fresh tarts? Mystical bejewelled skull? I'm just popping out to Dépanneur Nocturne, a lovely little game which came out in 2020 and I kept forgetting to post about. It's a small first-person explore-o-chatter set within a corner shop in a magical, mystical Montreal, full of things to admire, find, poke at, and chat about with the owner. And it'll only cost you about as much as a pint of semi-skimmed and loaf of Kingsmill from your own local shop.

notes.title: The Simply Vibing Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added Ambient Mode: Toggled from the main menu options, this launches the game in a special non-interactive [i]~vibes only~[/i] view of the store. If you ever just want to soak in the atmosphere of the Dépanneur Nocturne, you know where to look!
[*] Added one more item for purchase: What's new in store? You'll have to check with Eugénie for yourself!
[*] Added Toggle to disable look smoothing: Disables smoothing on player's look controls.
[*] Added field of view option:  You can now adjust the camera's field of view from the options menu.
[*] Fix: Controller directional pad should now work in menus.
[/list]

notes.title: Halloweve Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New Halloween content from now till the veil between this world and the spirit realm lifts again, including:
[*] Alternative costumes, seasonal decorations, pumpkin carvings, and the turnip has a horrible little face 
[*] New item available in the shop
[*] Some art improvements 
[*] Other festive secrets for all you ghosts and ghouls to uncover
[/list]

notes.title: Closing Time Update
notes.notes:

[*] Unique end vignettes for each gift choice, because every object has a deeper meaning
